description: This file implements network ping functionalities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, providing methods to execute ping commands and process their output, including support for IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, and resolving endpoints by name (e.g., 'CMTS') to network addresses.

methods.name: JsonObject _doPing(const string & guid,const string & endPoint,int packets)
methods.description: Performs a ping operation to a specified endpoint (IP or URL), collects and parses the ping results, returning a JSON object with detailed statistics and status.

methods.name: JsonObject _doPingNamedEndpoint(const string & guid,const string & endpointName,int packets)
methods.description: Resolves a named endpoint (like 'CMTS') to its IP address or gateway via interface info, then invokes _doPing to perform the ping.

ctags.name: _doPing
ctags.pattern: /^        JsonObject Network::_doPing(const string& guid, const string& endPoint, int packets)$/

ctags.name: _doPingNamedEndpoint
ctags.pattern: /^        JsonObject Network::_doPingNamedEndpoint(const string& guid, const string& endpointName,/
